source: Foundation 12 Daily Practice · Week 1 (student booklet + teacher answer key)
title: Class day warm-up
subtitle: Session 3 · warm-up with the 27 words and the alphabet
intro: Class day. This is a 15-minute warm-up only. Do not submit anything.

steps.title: 7A · Say the 27 words
lines: Read the 12 words from 1A and the 15 words from 3A aloud once. Then say which 3 words are still difficult.
steps.note: Write the 3 difficult words in your notebook.

steps.title: 7B · The alphabet
lines: Say the 7 letter groups in 5B once. Then spell your full name aloud 2 times.
steps.note: Say “double” for two letters the same.

steps.title: 7C · Look at your test
steps.instructions: Read your teacher's comments on your Tuesday test. Write 2 mistakes you will not make again.

open.q: Write 2 mistakes you will not make again.
